## What happened
Week 5, the first of mesocycle 2: all three lifting sessions and the short one, plus 20 minutes of cardio. The goblet squat and the Romanian deadlift kept climbing; the deadlift reached 65 kg for 10, the top of its range.

## Next week's targets
| Lift | Target (review, coming week) |
|---|---|
| Flat DB Bench Press | 55 lb × 6 |

## What changes and why
1. **Bench to 55 lb for 6.** Two sessions in a row under 6 reps at 60 lb, so about 8 % lighter, then build back. Its e1RM has held within 2 % for three sessions, which is a stall: the triage starts at step 1, sleep and food before any change to the plan.
2. **Deadlift to 70 kg for 8.** Every set reached 10.

## This week's focus
Lights out by 23:00 on at least five nights. Sleep averaged 6.5 h this week; the stall check looks for 7.
